choose.when:
<set-variable name="solc-response-body" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        
        
        
        
        @{
          var corr   = (string)context.Variables["solc-correlation-id"];
          var reqLen = ((string)context.Variables["solc-request-body"] ?? "").Length;
          var respLen= ((string)context.Variables["solc-response-body"] ?? "").Length;
          var meta = new JObject(
            new JProperty("kind", "summary"),
            new JProperty("correlationId", corr),
            new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
            new JProperty("apiId", context.Api.Id),
            new JProperty("operation", context.Operation.Id),
            new JProperty("method", context.Request.Method),
            new JProperty("url", context.Request.OriginalUrl.ToString()),
            new JProperty("status", context.Response.StatusCode),
            new JProperty("durationMs", (long)(DateTime.UtcNow - context.Timestamp).TotalMilliseconds),
            new JProperty("requestLength", reqLen),
            new JProperty("responseLength", respLen),
            new JProperty("requestChunks", (int)context.Variables["solc-req-chunks"]),
            new JProperty("responseChunks", (int)context.Variables["solc-resp-chunks"]),
            new JProperty("subscriptionId", context.Subscription?.Id ?? ""),
            new JProperty("clientIp", context.Request.IpAddress)
          );
          return meta.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
        }
        
        @{
          var corr = (string)context.Variables["solc-correlation-id"];
          var body = (string)context.Variables["solc-request-body"] ?? "";
          var size = 700000;
          var total = (int)context.Variables["solc-req-chunks"];
          var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
          for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            var chunk = body.Substring(i*size, Math.Min(size, body.Length - i*size));
            var ev = new JObject(
              new JProperty("kind", "request-body"),
              new JProperty("correlationId", corr),
              new JProperty("chunkIndex", i),
              new JProperty("chunkTotal", total),
              new JProperty("payload", chunk)
            );
            sb.AppendLine(ev.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None));
          }
          return sb.ToString();
        }
        
        @{
          var corr = (string)context.Variables["solc-correlation-id"];
          var body = (string)context.Variables["solc-response-body"] ?? "";
          var size = 700000;
          var total = (int)context.Variables["solc-resp-chunks"];
          var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
          for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            var chunk = body.Substring(i*size, Math.Min(size, body.Length - i*size));
            var ev = new JObject(
              new JProperty("kind", "response-body"),
              new JProperty("correlationId", corr),
              new JProperty("chunkIndex", i),
              new JProperty("chunkTotal", total),
              new JProperty("payload", chunk)
            );
            sb.AppendLine(ev.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None));
          }
          return sb.ToString();
        }
